prompt: Both bags reached the exact same weight, so mine is (heavy) yours.
explanation_ru: Обе сумки весят одинаково, поэтому для сравнения равенства используется конструкция as + прилагательное + as.

prompt: This thin cotton blanket isn't nearly (warm) my wool one at night.
explanation_ru: Хлопковое одеяло греет хуже шерстяного; после отрицания с nearly используется конструкция as … as (допустимо и so … as).

prompt: Fold the travel bag (small) possible so it fits under the train seat.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение as + прилагательное + as possible переводится как «настолько …, насколько возможно».

prompt: "Did we get equal space?" "Yes, your new bedroom is ___ mine."
explanation_ru: Для сравнения совпадения по параметру нужна конструкция the same + существительное + as. Типичная ошибка — ставить like вместо as или опускать артикль the.

prompt: Ciaran's new skipping rope is as long than the club's old rope.
answer: Ciaran's new skipping rope is as long as the club's old rope.
accepted_answers: Ciaran's new skipping rope is as long as the club's old rope.
explanation_ru: В конструкции равенства второй союз — всегда as, а не than (частая ошибка — смешивать as … as и сравнительную степень с than).

prompt: Our family moved into a new house in Bristol. The two upstairs bedrooms have matching floors, so my sister's room is (same / size) mine. Downstairs, the kitchen is (twice / big) my bedroom, so everyone eats there. Even our dog sleeps under the kitchen table.
explanation_ru: Для одинакового размера используется the same size as, а для кратного сравнения («вдвое больше») — twice as + прилагательное + as.

prompt: Does the bus around the park really take (half / much / time) the route over the busy bridge?
explanation_ru: Для значения «в два раза меньше времени» с неисчисляемым существительным time используется конструкция half as much time as.

prompt: We didn't collect nearly (much / money) we needed for the new gym heater, so we organised a cake sale.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным money в отрицательном сравнении используется конструкция as much money as (также допустимо so much money as).

prompt: "Which repair shop did you choose?" "The smaller one, because their quote was (half / expensive) the city garage's."
explanation_ru: Кратное сравнение «в два раза дешевле / вдвое менее дорогой» строится по модели half as + прилагательное + as.

prompt: When the oak desk arrived, the rough wood looked completely ___ the smooth surface in the online photos.
explanation_ru: После глагола-связки look нужно прилагательное different с предлогом from (в британском английском также возможно to). Типичная ошибка — ставить with или as.

prompt: The steep hill track is more dangerous than the valley path. → The valley path isn't …
answer: The valley path isn't as dangerous as the steep hill track.
accepted_answers: The valley path isn't as dangerous as the steep hill track.
The valley path isn't so dangerous as the steep hill track.
The valley path is not as dangerous as the steep hill track.
The valley path is not so dangerous as the steep hill track.
explanation_ru: Сравнение «A опаснее, чем B» перефразируется в отрицательное сравнение «B не такой опасный, как A» через not as/so + прилагательное + as.

prompt: Priya cut several important facts from her second report, so her manager could not use it instead of the first one.
options: Her second report was almost as informative as the first one.
Her second report was twice as informative as the first one.
Her first report wasn't as informative as the second one.
Her second report wasn't as informative as the first one.
explanation_ru: Поскольку во втором отчёте не хватает важных фактов, он менее информативен, чем первый: wasn't as informative as.

prompt: My brother's spare bedroom is nearly as quiet as the community studio, so we record our podcast there.
answer: My brother's spare bedroom is nearly as quiet as the community studio, so we record our podcast there.
accepted_answers: My brother's spare bedroom is nearly as quiet as the community studio, so we record our podcast there.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: конструкция nearly as + прилагательное + as правильно передаёт значение «почти такой же тихий, как».

prompt: I bought new plastic pipes for our garden tap, hoping for an easy repair. Unfortunately, the new parts aren't quite (wide) the old metal ones. Water doesn't flow nearly (fast) before, and the joints look completely (different) the picture on the box. Tomorrow morning I will take them back to the shop.
explanation_ru: В первом и втором пропусках отрицательное сравнение строится через as … as (с прилагательным wide и наречием fast), а в третьем после different нужен предлог from (или to).

prompt: Marek ran twelve short interviews after our office survey finished. The chats didn't include nearly (many / people) the online form, because everyone came from one floor. Even so, the staff explained their problems almost (clearly) the outside consultants did. Their main suggestions were surprisingly (similar) the answers we got from customers.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым people используется as many people as, с глаголом explained — наречие as clearly as, а после similar всегда ставится предлог to.

prompt: Surprisingly, the replacement phone battery lasts nowhere near (long) the original one, and its charge drops (three times / quickly) in cold weather.
explanation_ru: После оборота nowhere near («и близко не…») используется конструкция as … as, а при кратном сравнении скорости («в три раза быстрее») — three times as + наречие.

prompt: While the updated rental agreement isn't quite (strict) the previous one, tenants still have to give (same / notice) everyone did before.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске not quite as/so strict as выражает неполное равенство, а во втором используется модель the same + существительное + as.

prompt: Sofia's essay uses plenty of formal phrases, yet it does not explain the real causes of the strike ___ the short chapter in our textbook.
explanation_ru: Глагол explain требует наречия clearly в паре as … as. Типичные ошибки — ставить прилагательное (clear) вместо наречия или путать союзы as и than.

prompt: Tunde noticed that the two short stories have the same length, even though the second one took him twice more time than the first to finish.
answer: Tunde noticed that the two short stories have the same length, even though the second one took him twice as much time as the first to finish.
accepted_answers: Tunde noticed that the two short stories have the same length, even though the second one took him twice as much time as the first to finish.
Tunde noticed that the two short stories have the same length, even though the second one took him twice as long as the first to finish.
explanation_ru: В кратном сравнении нельзя говорить twice more … than — правильная модель с неисчисляемым time: twice as much time as (или twice as long as).

prompt: I picked up the revised guidebook to northern Spain before booking our autumn trip. On the shelf, the new paperback looks almost (thick) the original edition from ten years ago. Inside, however, it doesn't describe village festivals nearly (carefully) the first writer did, and it includes (few / maps) the older copy. For anyone travelling by bus, the old book is still worth keeping.
explanation_ru: С модификатором almost используется as thick as, с глаголом describe в отрицании — наречие as carefully as, а с исчисляемым существительным maps — сравнительная форма fewer maps than.

prompt: Wei spent a weekend cleaning up an old tape of her grandfather playing the piano. After she removed the heavy hiss, the piano notes sounded nearly (clear) a modern studio file. Her grandfather's voice still doesn't come through quite (loudly) the music, though you can understand every word now. Even so, the finished track sounds completely (different) the noisy cassette we found in the loft.
explanation_ru: После глагола-связки sound нужно прилагательное (as clear as и different from/to), а с глаголом движения звука come through — наречие в отрицательном сравнении (as loudly as).
